caption: Fighting withdrawal: an engaged Infantry regiment is ordered (plain right-click MOVE) out of a melee it cannot win. Before this PR the unit obeyed by pivot-turning in place inside the press -- facing swung through 180 degrees while marching, the slot grid swept across the whole block depth, and body pairs stayed stacked (nnd_min under 2.25 wu) chasing slots they could never settle onto. Now the disciplined block peels straight BACK holding the exact facing it fought in -- taking rear strikes for it, the documented cost of disengaging against an unbroken pursuer -- while every soldier keeps tracking its formation slot; nearest-neighbour spacing clears overlap by mid-withdrawal and spreads to a 9.0 wu median. Watch the flags and ranks stay square to the enemy during the entire back-pedal. The clip ends before morale breaks; the drilled about-face that completes the move once contact clears is covered by test/unit/test_fighting_withdrawal.gd.
